caveat: Research preview. Every relation is machine-extracted from PubMed abstracts by a rule-based extractor and has NOT been reviewed by a human (review_status = unreviewed). Extractor accuracy is known only on an LLM-assisted 30-paper development pilot (precision 0.52, recall 0.81, F1 0.64); that is not a held-out result and supports no generalization claim. Counts describe how much evidence was extracted, not how well a vector performs. Nothing here predicts tropism, immunogenicity, manufacturability or efficacy.

provenance.extraction: rule-based sentence-level relation extractor (version 10) over PubMed abstracts
provenance.identity_resolution: typography normalization and a hand-reviewed alias registry; no merging of variants, pseudotypes or cargo
provenance.bibliographic_metadata: NCBI PubMed (E-utilities esummary) and Europe PMC (licence)
provenance.build: deterministic; the complete audit record is kept privately by the project

exclusion.rule: Papers reserved for independent evaluation (a sealed held-out set and a calibration set), papers used in an annotation pilot, and their near-duplicates are excluded. Their identifiers are not published.

source_verification.rule: A paper is shown only if its PubMed record exists, its PubMed title matches the corpus title (normalized similarity >= 0.9, or the corpus title is a prefix of at least 30 normalized characters of the PubMed title), and it is not a retraction. The PubMed title is the one displayed.

excerpts.rule: Abstracts are never published. A source sentence is reproduced only when the article's Creative Commons licence is stated in Europe PMC licence metadata; it is then shown verbatim and unmodified, with attribution and the licence. Otherwise only bibliographic metadata and the PubMed link are shown.

policy.review: No relation in this artifact has been checked by a human. review_status is 'unreviewed' for every relation; an author-checked label is only ever added from an explicit, recorded check.
